chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I went for lethal. Nibbit is at 34 HP and I have 2 Energy, and the free cards do most of the work. Both Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense are 0-cost for 6 each, so that is 12 damage for nothing and, importantly, two cards Exhausted this turn. Send the Runner is also 0-cost: it draws me a card and Exhausts a third (I pitch a Coral Guard, which is dead weight in a line where the enemy dies). Then Tidal Barrage for 1 Energy Exhausts a fourth card and deals 5 plus 3 per card Exhausted this turn — with three already gone before it, that is at least 5+9=14, and 17 if its own Exhaust counts toward its own total. Last Energy goes to All Streams Flow to the Sea: printed 9, and with Charge at 8 read at one point per two Charge that is 9+4=13. Floor total is 12+14+13=39 against 34 HP, so the kill lands even on the stingiest reading of Tidal Barrage's counter, and the incoming 12 never happens.
q2_other_line_considered: Yes — the turtle line: Shinobu — Grass Ring of Sanctification for 4 plus two Coral Guard for 5 each is 14 Block against a telegraphed 12, eating the hit entirely, with the two Gorou thrown in for 12 chip damage on top. I checked it because I am at 48/70 and taking nothing is tempting. I dropped it once I counted the damage twice and confirmed lethal clears with margin even under the conservative Tidal Barrage reading. I also briefly considered skipping Send the Runner, since Gorou/Gorou + Tidal Barrage + All Streams already reaches 36 on the pessimistic count; I kept it because it is free, adds a guaranteed +3 to Tidal Barrage, and the card it Exhausts is a Coral Guard I have no use for in a killing turn.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gives up all defense — 0 Block held — so if the damage math is wrong anywhere (Charge reading softer than one point per two, Tidal Barrage counting fewer Exhausts than I assumed, or hidden Block on Nibbit that the packet does not show) I eat the full 12 and drop to 36/70 with three Coral Guard and Shinobu wasted. It also burns both Gorou permanently, spends the Charge payoff, and throws away a Coral Guard to Send the Runner — all resources that would matter if the fight continued. It is a line that is either free or fully punished; there is no middle.
q4_different_intent: Yes. The intent barely mattered for the kill itself, but it decides the fallback. If Nibbit's HP had been high enough that lethal was off the table, a telegraphed 12 would have pushed me straight to the turtle line — Shinobu plus two Coral Guard is 14 Block, which fully absorbs it, with the two free Gorou still swung for chip. If the telegraph had been a small attack or a non-damaging buff/debuff instead, I would have skipped Block entirely and spent the turn on damage and setup regardless of whether the kill was reachable this turn. And if the intent were an attack large enough that 14 Block could not cover it anyway, I would go back to maximum damage, since partial blocking would be wasted.
